## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Tenant-scoped materialized views
- Incremental, exactly-once updates with per-tenant sequence numbers
- Per-tenant quotas and backpressure
- Checkpointed replay and eviction strategies
- Observability and testability across tenants

## Code Example
```javascript
function applyDelta(view, delta){
  if(delta.seq <= view.lastSeq) return; // idempotent
  view.data[delta.key] = delta.value;
  view.lastSeq = delta.seq;
}
```

- How to monitor per-tenant memory and enforce quotas without affecting others?

## Why This Is Asked
This question probes tenancy revocation, data privacy, and live-system safety under real-world SLAs.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant policy enforcement with low-latency revocation
- In-flight event draining and shadow routing
- Field masking for analytics without breaking schemas
- Auditability, rollback, and canary-driven rollout

## Code Example
```yaml
policies:
  revokeAtSeconds: 120
  maskPII: true
  audit: true
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test canary rollout at scale without impacting tenants?
- What metrics indicate a safe rollback should occur?
